title: ULTRA X-TREME HUNTING SIMULATOR 2001
description:
(!!!Epilepsy Warning, This Game contains scenes with flashing lights!!!)

WELCOME TO ULTRA X-TREME HUNTING SIMULATOR 2001:

----------------------------------------------------------------

ULTRA X-TREME HUNTING SIMULATOR 2001 will bring the classic arcade experience from 1995 to your bedroom with this fast paced, addictive arcade shooter! 

Hunt and Kill as many deer as you can!Explore Sequota National Forest!

7 Level Locations! 42 Hunting Spots! 3 Extra Challenge Levels(coming soon)!

The all new control and aim mechanics will make this a must pick up and play arcade shooter experience. Travel around and take down wild game in the many levels and bonus challenges. 

Play alone and compete for the highest score! 

The perfect game for Hot Blooded Hunters, with easy to pick up controls that still pack a challenge for experienced players!
description_short: ULTRA X-TREME HUNTING SIMULATOR 2001 is a short horror hunting sim that satirizes low budget edutainment games with dark humor and absurdist horror.
